verdict.reasons: Core defect: The authoritative drip-tape carton roll has been used as operating hardware; a pressure gauge is physically mounted to a threaded port on the top surface of the packaging. This represents a clear substitution of the product package for functional plumbing infrastructure. Additionally, the secondary text on the carton ('Drip Tefioking Tepe') is gibberish and does not match the authentic 'Drip Irrigation Tape' branding shown in the approved reference, confirming fake/invented text. The evidence does not meet the technical requirement for a continuous irrigation header.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
